WP: We’ve created a token that is inherently “antithetical” to the Pumping of Dogecoin. Everytime
the famous Billionaire tweets using any of the words “𝗗𝗼𝗴𝗲”, “𝗗𝗼𝗴𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗶𝗻”, or “𝗕𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗶𝗻”.  𝗪𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗨𝗥𝗡 𝟭𝟬𝟬 𝗺𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗙𝗔𝗠𝗢𝗠 𝘁𝗼𝗸𝗲𝗻𝘀..

From the WP:  This Burn will be for every single new tweet, by the famous Billionaire, per the (BR), but
regardless to how many times the words “Doge”, or “Dogecoin”, or “Bitcoin” are used within the
tweet or tweet replies.

FameMom - the novel Anti-Billionaire-Shilling token.
Be a part of a Token that literally burns (becomes more scarce) when a Famous Billionaire Tweets the words, "Doge" "Dogecoin" or "Bitcoin".....be a part of something that functions against his manipulations. #FameMom @elonmusk https://t.co/kFxQFMbnz2

It's been close to 2 months since @elonmusk has shilled @dogecoin or @Bitcoin properly on Twitter (meeting the BR requirement for FameMom) We predicted quiet after the Anon threats..  but are taken aback at the Billionaire shills lack of ⚾️🥎..  aka Elon's still in "buy" mode..

We have considered Elon's latest lame attempt to associate D.O.G.E as $DOGE with @DOGE handle. We've decided "@DOGE" does not meet the burn requirement as the character disassociates from actual DOGE or DOGECOIN. Shill's gonna shill but this is low even for Elon's standards.
